# Content Edit & Blur

> Content Edit & Blur is a free, open-source desktop browser extension for editing webpage text and images, redacting sensitive information, de-emphasizing non-sensitive content, annotating pages, and capturing clean screenshots. The extension has no account, analytics, backend, or external requests and does not transmit page content; the underlying website remains connected.

Use the product overview for concise, citation-ready facts. Store counts and ratings change over time; treat dated figures as snapshots and use the linked store listings for current values.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://hasanaboshally.github.io/web-content-edit-and-blur--browser-extension/index.md): Concise capabilities, privacy behavior, browser support, usage, and dated adoption figures in Markdown.
- [Interactive website](https://hasanaboshally.github.io/web-content-edit-and-blur--browser-extension/): Product landing page with a working browser-based demo.
- [Project README](https://github.com/HasanAboShally/web-content-edit-and-blur--browser-extension/blob/master/README.md): Installation, tools, shortcuts, permissions, privacy, and contribution details.

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/content-edit-blur/adgnogkndmhcblbonkhgfbbngeghpboh): Official Chrome listing.
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/content-edit-blur): Official Firefox listing.
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/content-edit-blur/chlpcaigaedflhkfgmhkpknlcchkeodl): Official Edge listing.
